tagline: Ride share, bikes, scooters, and more: all in one app
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross Bookings is the primary indicator of Lyft platform size and momentum, capturing global market growth before cost deductions. It is the fundamental driver of revenue and profitability trajectory, amplified by international expansion in 2025.

kpis.name: Gross Bookings Value
kpis.explanation: Total value of transactions on the platform, excluding tips.
kpis.description: Up 15% in 2025 driven by international expansion and improved market health. Includes rides, bike rentals, scooters, and chauffeur services.
kpis.signal: Strong platform growth driven by internationalization.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Operating income adjusted for certain non-recurring costs.
kpis.description: Increased from $382.4M to $528.8M in 2025, supported by improved efficiency and volume growth.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned by Lyft from its services.
kpis.description: Revenue up 9% in 2025, driven by service fees, advertising, and new international offerings.
kpis.signal: Steady revenue growth aligned with platform expansion.

kpis.name: Active Users (Q4 2025)
kpis.explanation: Number of people who took at least one ride in the fourth quarter.
kpis.description: 29.2 million active users in Q4 2025, +18% vs. 2024, driven by engagement and geographic expansion.
kpis.signal: Rapid user base growth, indicating strong adoption.

kpis.name: Number of Rides
kpis.explanation: Total number of trips completed via the Lyft app.
kpis.description: 945.5 million rides in 2025, +14% vs. 2024, thanks to improved market health and user engagement.
kpis.signal: Increasing platform utilization despite reduction in shared rides.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash available after operating and investment expenses.
kpis.description: FCF of $1,115.6M in 2025, up significantly thanks to revenue growth and cost discipline.
kpis.signal: Major improvement in cash generation and financial discipline.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Total profit after all charges and taxes, including one-time items.
kpis.description: $2,844M net income in 2025 versus $22.8M in 2024, primarily driven by a $2.9B gain from tax reserve release. Net income does not reflect core operational performance.
kpis.signal: Explosive net income in 2025, largely impacted by a $2.9B one-time tax reserve release gain.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €9.03B in the latest year

kpis.name: International Expansion
kpis.explanation: Entry into 9 new countries and over 180 cities via Freenow acquisition.
kpis.description: In July 2025, Lyft acquires Freenow (Intelligent Apps GmbH), marking its entry into Europe and shift to global scale with presence in 6 continents and over 180 cities.
kpis.signal: First significant expansion outside North America, marking entry into Europe.

kpis.name: Acquisitions (2025)
kpis.explanation: Total amount paid for strategic acquisitions Freenow and TBR in 2025.
kpis.description: Lyft spends $236.8M for Freenow (July 2025) and $115.2M for TBR (October 2025), totaling $352M, to strengthen its position in taxis, premium chauffeur, and international mobility.
kpis.signal: Major strategic investment to expand offering and global geographic coverage.
